entry.note: Identified from the title page (arXiv:2208.13448v2, dated July 6 2023 in the header, two authors, 37 pp, 18 sections). No ref() entry, none created (tangential).

relevance.rationale: An algorithm for the difference Galois group of an order-THREE equation over a large class of difference operators (shift, q-difference over C(z^{1/*}), Mahler, elliptic), reducing to ancillary problems (rational / hyperexponential solutions of Riccati-type equations), with criteria for the irreducible and imprimitive cases and a differential-transcendence corollary. Read: §1, §2.1 (Zudilin's Rogers-Ramanujan double sum U(z,t) and its order-3 q-difference equation (1.1); Thm 6.13: its Galois group over C(z^{1/*}) is GL_3(C) for all t != 0, hence no algebraic differential relations among U(z,t), U(qz,t), U(q^2z,t)), Thm 2.1 (reduction of the system into the Galois group), §3.2 Thm 3.3/3.5 and Prop 3.7-3.10 (imprimitive case, prime order), §3.3 Prop 3.18 (primitive case: SO_3 vs SL_3), §6.4 (the algorithm summarised), §7 Thm 7.1 (a three-condition partial-transcendence criterion for order 3). Corpus-grep for a consumer: the only order-3 q-difference objects are (a) the 4_1 strong-AJ operator in computations/figure_eight_aj_operator.py, cited to nguyen-tran-2021 and not re-derived, whose Galois group nobody asks for, and (b) the rank-3 base q-connection of the W1 wall, which QOU/Mass/ColorCubicIrreducible.lean and docs/audits/2026-09-04-w1-route1-base-qshift-rationality-prune.md PROVE does not exist as a rational system (so there is no order-3 equation there to compute a Galois group of); 'Rogers-Ramanujan' / 'Nahm sum' have no content-block consumer; 'Dreyfus' / 'Poulet' have zero hits. Scope-(a): no block, probe or bean wants an order-3 difference Galois group or a differential-transcendence statement, so this document as read supplies nothing consumable. Recorded for a future reader: if the Galois group of the order-3 AJ operator of 4_1 were ever wanted, §6.4 is the algorithm (Case Q) and Thm 7.1 the transcendence criterion.

proposedActions.rationale: No named block computes an order-3 difference Galois group; the one candidate object (the rank-3 base q-connection) is proved not to exist and the other (the 4_1 AJ operator) has no Galois-group consumer.
